messages.subject: Update on Stan.jl (Stan for Julia users)
parts:
Stan’s home page contains a link to a Julia interface to Stan.jl for those interested in Stan + Julia.

Below a short update on what has changed over the last 2 months or so:

1. Fixed several issues to make Stan.jl work on Windows.

2. Using Mamba to display and diagnose simulation results.

The call to stan() to sample now returns a Mamba Chains object (previously it returned a dictionary).

3. The ability to select which variables to extract form Stan’s output .csv file(s).

Saves time if there are many, many observed variables.

4. Inline definition of model and data in the .jl file.

Compile only the first time or when the model is modified (as detected by ‘make’). Or use an external .stan file.

5. The ability to execute Stan simulations in parallel.

This is in fact the default.

6. JuliaBox

For those who don’t want to install *any* software, have an account on JuliaBox and access to a browser.

Thanks to Viral, Tanmay and Shashi for installing CmdStan on JuliaBox! JuliaBox gives users a Notebook like interface.

A few example notebooks are included in Stan.jl v”0.2.0” in the Examples/Notebooks subdirectory.
